dedupe_keys.name: eu china bridge multi level policy inventories for the steel and chemical industries

description: These inventories map policies for decarbonising energy-intensive industries in the EU and China, made in the EU-China BRIDGE project. The Zenodo records say the project produces three public inventories (iron and steel, chemicals and a third sector); the steel inventory (deliverable D4.1, 30 September 2025, by Chun Xia-Bauer and Maike Venjakob of the Wuppertal Institute) holds Chinese and EU steel policy mappings in two Excel files, and the chemical inventory (D4.6, 30 November 2025, with Hui Kong of the Beijing Institute of Technology) maps chemical defossilisation policies across levels of government, with case studies of Germany and Inner Mongolia. Each is a small zip of about 70 KB, free to download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the EU and China, national and sub-national. Caveats: they are policy lists, not measured data, and the third inventory was not found in the search. For simulation they give which instruments apply where, to set policy drivers in industrial transition scenarios. Related catalogue records include the TRANSIENCE policies and technologies database and the Mopo Industry Technology Catalogue.
